mapper.select: select fmc.business_type, fflc.dir_name , fflc.dir_code, fflc.sort_code, fcc.condition_key from filing_materials_config fmc inner join filing_first_level_config fflc on fmc.id = fflc.filing_materials_config_id left join filing_condition_config fcc on fflc.condition_key = fcc.condition_key and fcc.enable_flag = '1' where fmc.enable_flag = '1' and fflc.enable_flag = '1' and fmc.filing_type = #{filingType}

select fmc.business_type, fflc.dir_name , fflc.dir_code, fflc.sort_code, fcc.condition_key from filing_materials_config fmc inner join filing_first_level_config fflc on fmc.id = fflc.filing_materials_config_id left join filing_condition_config fcc on fflc.condition_key = fcc.condition_key and fcc.enable_flag = '1' where fmc.enable_flag = '1' and fflc.docx_enable_flag = '1' and fmc.filing_type = #{filingType}

select fmc.business_type, fflc.dir_name , fflc.dir_code, fflc.sort_code from filing_materials_config fmc inner join filing_first_level_config fflc on fmc.id = fflc.filing_materials_config_id where fmc.enable_flag = '1' and fflc.enable_flag = '1' and fflc.require_flag = '1' and fmc.filing_type = #{filingType}
